mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( order_id, review_content, analysis_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{reviewContent}, 'PENDING', NOW(6), NOW(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json AS analysisResultJson, DATE_FORMAT(analyzed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS analyzedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json AS analysisResultJson, DATE_FORMAT(analyzed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS analyzedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json AS analysisResultJson, DATE_FORMAT(analyzed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS analyzedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json AS analysisResultJson, DATE_FORMAT(analyzed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS analyzedAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE analysis_status = 'PENDING' OR ( analysis_status = 'FAILED' AND updated_at < #{failedRetryDeadline} ) ORDER BY review_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'COMPLETED', analysis_result_json = #{analysisResultJson}, analyzed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'FAILED', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE analysis_status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{processingTimeoutDeadline}
